sysd-scale-002.caption: Every Yes vote leads to commit; one No or a timeout leads to rollback.
sysd-scale-002.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Coordinator asks all to commit] --> B[Participants vote Yes or No]
B --> C{Every vote Yes?}
C -->|yes| D[Coordinator sends commit]
C -->|no or timeout| E[Coordinator sends rollback]
D --> F[Participants complete and acknowledge]
E --> G[Participants undo and acknowledge]

sysd-scale-004.caption: The added pre-commit step must be acknowledged before the final commit is sent.
sysd-scale-004.mermaid:
flowchart LR
A[Vote] --> B[Coordinator sends pre-commit]
B --> C[Participants acknowledge]
C --> D[Coordinator sends commit]

sysd-scale-016.caption: The four messages of one Basic Paxos round, in order.
rows: Proposer to a quorum of Acceptors

sysd-scale-022.caption: A follower that hears no heartbeat becomes a candidate; a majority of votes makes it leader, a split vote starts a new term.
sysd-scale-022.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Follower] -->|election timeout passes| B[Candidate]
B -->|majority of votes| C[Leader]
B -->|split vote| D[New term, new election]
D --> B

sysd-scale-117.caption: Going from five replicas to six lowers the share that can be down.
sysd-scale-117.unit: % of replicas that can be down

sysd-scale-116.caption: Round-trip time, one of the two physical limits on consensus, grows with distance.

sysd-scale-025.caption: The client asks the master where a chunk lives, then reads from a chunkserver directly.
sysd-scale-025.mermaid:
flowchart TD
C[Client] -->|1. ask for location| M[Master: metadata only]
C -->|2. read the data| S[Chunkserver]
S -.->|3 copies by default| R[Other chunkservers]

sysd-scale-041.caption: A MapReduce job passes through seven stages from input to output.
sysd-scale-041.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Input reader] --> B[Map]
B --> C[Partition]
C --> D[Shuffle]
D --> E[Sort]
E --> F[Reduce]
F --> G[Output writer]

sysd-scale-030.caption: The p99 latencies Discord reports for ScyllaDB and for Cassandra.
